item.title: Blog: KubeClipper 1.7 documentation: installation through troubleshooting
item.description:
We refreshed the KubeClipper v1.7.0 documentation so new and existing users can follow tasks from installation to troubleshooting. This is a documentation update. The v1.7.0 software was released on September 8, 2026; see the 1.7 release notes for shipped capabilities and component versions.

  • Getting started covers host preparation, platform deployment, a test cluster, and completion checks.
  • Upgrading lists pre-upgrade checks and operational boundaries.
  • Operations and logs explains asynchronous task status, logs, retry, and cancellation.
  • Platform diagnostics helps distinguish platform, Agent, resource, and cluster failures.
  • The version menu links to archived documentation for 1.1 through 1.6; current documentation covers v1.7.0.

If a step is wrong or a use case is missing, open a documentation issue. Include the page URL, your version, and redacted error details.
